message.text:
The derived metadata is stored in `MemoPayload`.

Tags and property are derived from content. Location is user-set. Snippets are generated at API conversion time. The primary extraction logic is in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` via `ExtractAll`, a goldmark AST walker.

`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` contains `RebuildMemoPayload`, which assigns the extracted tags and property to each memo.

The rebuild is triggered by three events:
- `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`
- `UpdateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, but only when the update mask path is `"content"`
- `Runner.RunOnce` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, which is a maintenance-only batch job and is not wired to server startup

`CreateMemoComment` delegates to `CreateMemo`, so it also triggers a rebuild.

Tags are extracted from markdown `#tag` tokens via a custom TagNode extension, excluding tags inside links or images, then deduplicated while preserving case.

Property tracks five boolean flags: `has_link`, `has_code`, `has_task_list`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, and `title`. Title comes from the first block-level H1 heading in the document.

ExtractAll also extracts mentions, but RebuildMemoPayload only assigns Tags and Property to the memo payload. Mentions are not persisted to the stored payload.

The answer will follow the three-part format: computation site; triggers; extracted properties.

Computation site: `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (`ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`). Triggered by `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` (`RebuildMemoPayload`) writing results to `memo.Payload`. Snippet derivation: `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (`GenerateSnippet`) via `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` (`getMemoContentSnippet`) at API response time. Snippet is not stored in `MemoPayload`; it is computed on read.

Triggers: CreateMemo in `memo_service.go`, UpdateMemo when the content field is in the update mask, and the memopayload Runner.RunOnce batch for maintenance.

Extracted properties: tags, plus property fields `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, and `title` drawn from the first H1 heading. Snippet is a separate output-only plain-text summary used for previews.

h14.

**Computation site:** Content is parsed once with goldmark in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (`ExtractAll`; same logic also exists as `ExtractTags` and `ExtractProperties`). Results are written to the stored `MemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` via `RebuildMemoPayload`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll` and sets `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`. List/preview **snippets** are derived separately at API conversion time in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` (`getMemoContentSnippet` → `MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`), used from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`.

**Triggers:** `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` runs on **CreateMemo** (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, before persist) and on **UpdateMemo** only when the update mask includes `"content"` (same file). **CreateMemoComment** triggers it indirectly by calling `CreateMemo`. `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` can batch-rebuild all memos; it is not started from `server/server.go` in this repo.

**Extracted properties:** Stored on `MemoPayload` (`proto/store/memo.proto`, exposed as API `Memo.tags` / `Memo.property` in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`):

- **`tags`:** `#tag` tokens from the custom tag extension (`internal/markdown/parser/tag.go`), excluding tags inside links/images, deduplicated with case preserved.
- **`property`:** `has_link` (link nodes), `has_code` (code block / fenced block / inline code), `has_task_list` (GFM task checkboxes), `has_incomplete_tasks` (unchecked tasks), `title` (plain text of the first document-level H1 heading, if any).

`MemoPayload.location` is user-supplied on create/update, not content-derived. **`snippet`** (plain-text summary for previews) is computed from content on read, not stored in `MemoPayload`.
